googleCherryPicks.note: Applied with git cherry-pick -x onto the Spelunker commit, bringing the engine level with google/neuroglancer master c8c4d139 (2026-10-28). 8a4d0844 and a9513e6a were already cherry-picked by Spelunker; src/skeleton/frontend.ts was then aligned with master because Spelunker's copy of the ANGLE fix predates the RGBA change. sourceTree is the tree after these picks and before local patches.

profile: Spelunker standalone browser with its state servers, custom input bindings, and segment color widget; no datasource, kvstore, or layer exclusion conditions

upstreamModifications.reason: Attach and safely remove the download link, revoke its object URL, and upgrade editor state before mutation with rollback on restoration failure.
Export a shared safe restoration helper, parse and upgrade before reset, and restore the previous workspace if replacement, additive, remote, or editor state restoration fails.
Cancel pending holds and clear gesture and multi-tap state when the browser cancels a touch sequence.
Expose Spelunker's complete binding and state-upgrader configuration for the mobile shell while retaining the default standalone setup.
Preserve the deployed viewer pathname and query in short links. Clipboard failures are handled upstream since google/neuroglancer da443d25 (Safari clipboard fix with a manual-copy fallback).

Dispose Time control listeners with their panel, invalidate pending changes when panels hide or dispose, ignore superseded changes, and recover visibly from failed historical-root or oldest-timestamp requests.
Connect OAuth2 requests to provider-specific asynchronous error handlers so missing CAVE terms trigger the native acceptance and retry flow; recognize JSON content types with charset parameters.
Dispose the native tab view with its layer panel so Time and other cached tab controls cannot retain listeners or apply pending changes after the panel closes.
